target_customer: iPhone users with multiple rewards credit cards who pay by tap.
problem: Users do not know which card earns the most rewards at each purchase. Uno is a wallet that picks the card automatically at tap to pay.
business_model: Consumer app; monetization not found (rewards or interchange likely but not sourced)

founders.name: Mordi Shadpour
founders.background_notes: YC page lists a Bloomberg Terminal background item without naming an employer.

founders.name: Saket Joshi
founders.background_notes: YC page gives only a LinkedIn link. The founders reportedly met at a Harvard startup mixer in 2023.

competitors.name: Kudos
competitors.what: AI smart wallet that picks the best card

competitors.name: Curve Pay
competitors.what: Wallet that routes taps to a chosen underlying card using smart rules

technical_complexity.rationale: Replacing Apple Pay's default tap flow on iPhone depends on platform permissions and card network integrations; the founders' technical depth is not documented.

defensibility.rationale: Several apps already pick cards; Apple controls the wallet surface.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Apple platform dependence is the central risk; no outcome yet.

market_need_then: Rewards optimization apps proliferated in 2026, indicating demand among points enthusiasts.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short and direct; headline Your wallet. Now with a brain

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with the card game and other products named Uno; no brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Uno Wallet is a two person Spring 2026 company with an early access iPhone wallet and no verified funding or traction. Heavy platform dependence on Apple and existing card picking apps make the path uncertain, but no outcome has occurred.
notes: FundedIQ reports a $500k pre-seed in June 2026 and VCBacked a pre-seed; single sourced aggregators, unverified, so no round recorded. A search snippet said Saket Joshi was previously at xAI; that came from an aggregator I did not open, so it is excluded. A third party article reproducing a June 2026 YC launch post was not verified. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed rests on a single outlet (FundedIQ, June 2026); VCBacked also lists a June 2026 pre-seed with Y Combinator but no amount.
